bar: ≥25 stars on GitHub, or ≥10 on GitLab/Codeberg (smaller populations, so the same count means more); licensed, pushed within 60 days, not archived, Herdr-specific — or official. Articles: substantive first-hand accounts. Link canonical homes, never mirrors.
notes: Authoritative over README.md. Rules live in .claude/skills/awesome-source-audit/SKILL.md. The marketplace held 605 herdr-plugin repositories at seed time; this ledger is the filter over it.

audits.notes: GitLab and Codeberg carry no qualifying Herdr project today: GitLab hits are noise, mirrors, or forks; Codeberg has two genuine 0-star plugins. herdr plugin install accepts GitHub owner/repo only, so non-GitHub plugins require clone + herdr plugin link.

Reddit could not be reached from this environment (reddit.com blocked, search proxies returned nothing relevant) — recorded as a gap, not as a clean result.
audits.changes: none — no admissions, no retirements, no strikes. Star counts and the marketplace size refreshed.

candidates: alexei-led/ccgram - sighting 1 of 3, 246 stars, MIT, borderline (dual multiplexer)
audits.notes: Phase 5 weakest-entry review: madarco/agentbox-herdr-plugin (26 stars, last push 2026-06-24, 54 days) is the weakest listed entry and a thin front end for its parent project. It still clears every bar today, so it stays listed; re-check next week because it breaches the 60-day liveness rule on 2026-08-23 if nothing lands. Section pressure noted: Remote and mobile holds 4 listed entries and 5 candidates queued, so it will hit the 8-entry soft cap around 2026-09-07 and will need a split or a replacement decision. The three license-blocked rejects were re-checked and all three are still unlicensed (pi-extensible-workflows 180, herdr-tab-smart-rename 41, herdr-board 33); joelhooks/pi-bellwether joins them. The only new dated Herdr event this week was a preview build (preview-2026-08-17), deliberately not added to Trending — preview-channel builds are not releases and listing them would pad the section.

sources.title: herdr-hunk-diff
sources.notes: Sighting 1 of 3. Review agent-authored diffs in hunk and send inline comments back to the responsible agent. herdr-plugin.toml at root; requires Herdr 0.8.0+, Node 22.12+, macOS/Linux. Overlaps herdr-reviewr — if both still qualify at sighting 3, compare before listing.

sources.title: herdr-web
sources.notes: Sighting 1 of 3. Browser client for a running Herdr session via a Rust HTTP/WebSocket bridge; works around Herdr allowing only one terminal attach owner. Requires Herdr 0.8.0+ and terminal protocol 19. No herdr-plugin.toml — a companion app, not a plugin.

sources.title: herdr-mobile
sources.notes: Sighting 1 of 3. Native iOS/Android client that connects to the separately deployed benkraus/herdr-plugin-mobile-relay. Distinct from the listed 0cv/herdr-mobile-relay.

sources.title: whip
sources.notes: Sighting 1 of 3. Android app for supervising Herdr over SSH/Tailscale; falls back to a plain SSH shell when Herdr is unavailable. AGPL-3.0 — licensed, but note the copyleft in any entry.

sources.title: agentslate
sources.notes: Sighting 1 of 3. iPhone remote keypad for supervising Herdr agents over Tailscale; requires Herdr 0.8.0+ for live control, ships an offline demo mode. Mac side installs via Homebrew.

sources.title: ccgram
sources.notes: Sighting 1 of 3, borderline. Telegram bridge for Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI that supports tmux OR Herdr (CCGRAM_MULTIPLEXER=herdr), with Herdr-specific session guarding via agent.list. Decide at sighting 3 whether dual-multiplexer support clears the Herdr-specific bar; the four Herdr-only remote candidates rank ahead of it.

sources.title: herdr-automatic-rename
sources.notes: Sighting 1 of 3. Renames Herdr tabs from the pane's foreground process (tmux automatic-rename style) and adds 1-9 jump keys. Requires Herdr 0.7.1+. Different mechanism from the listed sh1ma/herdr-auto-title, which names tabs from agent conversations.

sources.title: pi-herdr-squad
sources.notes: Sighting 1 of 3. Pi package (pi install npm:pi-herdr-squad) that runs read-only Herdr investigation squads; requires a Pi session in a Herdr-managed pane (HERDR_ENV=1).

sources.title: A deep dive into Herdr
sources.notes: Sighting 1 of 3. Published 2026-08-10. First-hand: names the repositories he runs it on, his tab layout (agents/dev/checks/deploy), a deliberately minimal config, and real limits found in use (parallel pushes blocking a Cloudflare Pages build queue).

sources.title: herdr and cmux: two shapes of the same agent multiplexer
sources.notes: Sighting 1 of 3. Published 2026-07-26. Substantive comparison with named Herdr limitations and a stated review date of 2027-01. Caveat to weigh at sighting 3: the author says outright he has not run Herdr in anger, so it is stronger on cmux than on Herdr.

trending.text: Herdr joined Y Combinator (Fall 2026); runtime stays Apache-2.0. One-person team; YC page cites 25k stars and 340k downloads in four months.
v0.8.0: herdr --skill, ui.tab_bar_position, keybind help filtering, Grok and Antigravity session reporting and native resume.
Blog: 'Ten agents, three clients, 95% less CPU' — rendering and status-indicator work for running a fleet.
v0.7.5: installed and linked plugins are now global to the user rather than per session; plugins installed in a named session on 0.7.3 need reinstalling.
#1 on GitHub Trending; ~15k stars in early July, 30,028 on 2026-08-17; marketplace at 684 repos, up from 605 five days earlier.
No company publicly documented as running Herdr in production could be found. Standing search target.
